Package org.codehaus.cargo.deployer.jetty

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    JettyDeployer.Context
    Provides the Jetty-specific context operations required by the deployer.
    JettyDeployer.Request
    Provides the request operations needed by the common deployer.
    JettyDeployer.Response
    Provides the response operations needed by the common deployer.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    DeployerServlet
    This servlet is used to control deploy, undeploy, redeploy, start, and stop a web application within the jetty server.
    DeployerServletJakarta
    Common Jakarta Servlet implementation used by the Cargo Jetty deployers.

    Jetty EE9, EE10 and EE11 subclasses provide the corresponding Jetty web application context implementation.
    DeployerServletJakartaEE10
    Servlet used by Cargo to remotely deploy and undeploy web applications on Jetty 12.1 Jakarta EE 10 environments.
    DeployerServletJakartaEE11
    Servlet used by Cargo to remotely deploy and undeploy web applications on Jetty 12.1 Jakarta EE 11 environments.
    DeployerServletJakartaEE9
    Servlet used by Cargo to remotely deploy and undeploy web applications on Jetty 12.1 Jakarta EE 9 environments.
    DeployerServletJavax
    Servlet used by Cargo to remotely deploy and undeploy web applications on Jetty 12.1 Java EE 8 environments.
    JettyDeployer
    Contains the common deployment logic used by the Jetty Cargo deployer servlets.

    This class deliberately has no dependency on either the Servlet API or the Servlet API.
    JettyDeployerJakartaEE10
    Jetty EE10 implementation of the Cargo deployer context.
    JettyDeployerJakartaEE11
    Jetty EE11 implementation of the Cargo deployer context.
    JettyDeployerJakartaEE9
    Jetty EE9 implementation of the Cargo deployer context.
    JettyDeployerJavax
    Jetty EE8 implementation of the Cargo deployer context.
    JettyDeployerJetty
    Provides common Jetty server operations for the Cargo deployer.
    JettyDeployerServlet
    Contains common servlet-independent initialization for the Cargo Jetty deployer servlets.

    This class contains no dependency on either the javax.servlet or jakarta.servlet APIs.
    JettyWebAppContext<T>
    Common Jetty context operations used by the Cargo Jetty deployer.
    JettyWebAppContextJavax
    Provides Jetty 12.1 Java EE 8 WebAppContext operations.
